summary: Read a single line that may hold spaces, punctuation, digits, and letters of either case. For the test, discard every character that is not a letter or a digit, and fold uppercase letters into lowercase. Write true when the remaining characters are identical forward and backward. Write false otherwise. When nothing remains after the discards, treat the line as valid and write true as well.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one token of text without spaces.
